hypotheses.S1_layer3_has_powerlaw_like_bulk: The observed rank-33--512 full-width tensor spectrum has log-log R2 at least 0.90.
hypotheses.S2_coordination_nulls_retain_bulk: Sign and Down/form pairing nulls have median R2 at least 0.90 and median exponent within 0.15 of observed.
hypotheses.S3_layer3_has_leading_strict_spike: The leading observed singular value lies above the bulk power-law extrapolation.
hypotheses.S4_layer3_has_four_strict_spikes: All four leading observed singular values lie above the bulk power-law extrapolation.
hypotheses.S5_spikes_exceed_all_coordination_nulls: Observed mean top-four log excess exceeds every sign and pairing null replicate.
hypotheses.S6_top4_are_globally_concentrated: The top four carry at least 3 percent of full raw tensor-map energy.
